body:
Deep within the fabric of reality laid hidden realms.
After a 4-6 hour drive from Raleigh, NC to La Fayette, GA, me and my hippy counterparts arrive at last. For 4 months I had been clean of cannabis but decided to dabble in for the rare occasion. I had also been drinking bud light and popped an Addy 15 mins before. My mind was at peace for the time being.
I had grown fond of my southern brethren as well as an attraction to 16 yr old hippy girl whom I've had been riding next to for the last 5 hours. I sat on a cloth and began paint with some girls. I overheard one of my fellow hippy brothers of 2c-b and ask the pricing. I had original sought out for LSD but decided that this would do. I asked how much to trip and then doubled that being my first time, I had set myself up for a mind fuck. I was given a strange blue liquid in water bottle and jugged.
I then sat back down and continued painting. A fellow friend joked drunken Lets sniff some beers" while he poured bud light over the 16 yr old girls leg. I busted out laughing but this was deeper, a gut laugh, this was the calling card of a dissociative. We smoked some more and I began to be pulled into my painting. I looked and tried to make sense of my surroundings. With about 7 out of 9 people tripping we all plunged into the dissociative abyss.
A redhead southern hippy handed me Ray Bradburys The Illustrated Man. I began to read it to keep some stability in the increasingly chaotic state. The words sharpened and it was if a choir was reading to me and I somehow feel into a trance. The words were like mixture of 70 different languish and I had only gotten through the first paragraph before I tripped out.
I stood and stumbled around and seen two girls from a distance. Walking over to them I noticed they had showered and were wearing no bras on as there nipples pierced through there thin shirts. I wobbled backward and began talking about my trip. your mike right? I like you, I giggled a bit. Then I fell deeper into the rabbit hole.
Over a white lake I travel out of my body and a voice guided me Its okay, Its a natural progression, everyone goes through this in their life What the fuck just happened? Everything rushes inwards into a fine point and bright light flashes. I briefly step of the trip only to realize little time has passed. I take my shirt off and then put it back on. Nothing makes ant sense yet everything is at peace. I stumble around the mountain tops and met up with some locals. I begin to babble about some gibberish when my first vision came to me.
In an alternate universe, My wallet had been stolen, by the redhead girl. My fellow hippy who gave me the drink says You know now how we do things here. I snap back yet somehow understand completely what just happened. I fall to the ground and began to draw. Another vision, Im holding a feather, Im being blamed for a girls murder, and my parents tell me I had let the feather on the computer screen. I begin to lose sense. I see the music manifest into colors as textures crawl across the surface of the air.
Then Im at the stage. A young blond raver is DJing I become in tranced by the music and attempt to join. However, due to my state I must of fuck something up Could you please not touch my computer. Strange in this chaos I can still recall embarassment but my feet swayed towards the center.
Finally, the come down. STIs Spiritual Transmitted Infection huddle around the circle of hippies as a jersey boy conversing my presence I had been through the rite of passage with 2c-b and now rejoice in strange bliss.
